description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取交易所对A股公司的问询函记录。可按股票代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回日期、问询函类型、类型描述、问询函标题、问询函链接URL、链接类型等数据。当用户想了解某A股是否收到交易所问询函、追踪监管问询进展时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain inquiry letter records from stock exchanges regarding A-share companies. Filters can be applied by stock code and date range, returning fields such as date, inquiry type, type description, inquiry letter title, inquiry letter link URL, and link type. Call this interface when users want to know whether an A-share has received inquiry letters from stock exchanges or track regulatory inquiry progress.
